items.question: Can I use it in client work?
items.answer: Yes. Anything you build, personal or commercial, with no credit needed.

items.question: Does it work with Tailwind?
items.answer: Every block ships as plain CSS, so it sits beside Tailwind or any setup you have.

items.question: Is there a dark mode?
items.answer: Each block reads two colour tokens, so it turns with your theme.

items.question: How often are blocks added?
items.answer: New ones land every week, and anything you copied stays yours.
